theme_strategy.description: A light-themed, high-contrast UI tailored for financial trust and clarity. Employee mobile interface is tactile with large touch targets and progressive disclosure. Admin desktop interface relies on dense, table-first structures and F-pattern scanning.

numbers.description: Crucial for all currency amounts and KPI metrics.

rules: Max heading size text-5xl on desktop, text-3xl on mobile.
Labels use uppercase, tiny size, wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).
No gradients for backgrounds. Keep surfaces matte and flat.
Status colors must meet 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
Emerald green used for primary action buttons (Collect, Share WhatsApp) to imply growth and success.
Dark Navy used for primary branding and Admin sidebar.

employee_mobile_portal.structure: Sticky Header with Role Toggle -> Scrollable Content -> Floating Action Button (Optional) or Sticky Bottom CTA.
employee_mobile_portal.spacing: Generous vertical spacing (gap-6) between cards. Full-width inputs and buttons.
employee_mobile_portal.touch_targets: All interactive elements must be min h-12 (48px) for field agents using mobile.

admin_desktop_portal.structure: Left Dark Sidebar (w-64) -> Top Header (Role Toggle & Global Search) -> Main Content Area.
admin_desktop_portal.grid: Bento Grid Protocol Mode B (High Density Grid). gap-4 or gap-6. Metric Cards span 1 col, Charts span 2-3 cols, Tables span full width.
admin_desktop_portal.cards: Flat background, 1px border-slate-200, no shadow. Slight shadow-sm on hover.

cards.style: Neumorphic Flat. bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl.

buttons.primary: bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white rounded-lg h-12 (mobile) or h-10 (desktop) font-medium transition-colors
buttons.whatsapp: bg-[#25D366] hover:bg-[#1DA851] text-white flex items-center justify-center gap-2

inputs.style: bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg h-12 (mobile) px-4 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 focus:border-emerald-500 transition-all

tables.header: bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider py-3 px-4 border-y border-slate-200

badges.style: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium

motion.page_transitions: Fade in with slight upward slide (translate-y-2 -> 0) using framer-motion.
motion.hover_states: Buttons and cards scale-up slightly (scale-[1.01]) or elevate shadow. Fast transition (duration-200).
motion.feedback: Toast notifications slide in from bottom (mobile) or top-right (desktop) for successful collections/expenses.

visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react for all standard UI icons. Stroke width 2 or 1.5.
visual_enhancers.charts: recharts. Use AreaCharts for trends with emerald gradient fill (opacity 0.2 to 0). BarCharts for daily collection comparisons.
visual_enhancers.receipt: Render receipt as a centered, visually distinct 'ticket' card with dashed top border, light gray bg, and monospace font for transaction ID.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against colored backgrounds is white or strictly contrasting.
accessibility.focus: All form inputs and buttons must have visible focus rings.
accessibility.aria: Use semantic HTML, roles, and aria-labels for icon-only buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install lucide-react, recharts, framer-motion, date-fns, sonner.
Create a responsive shell: If user is in Employee View, use a mobile-app layout (max-w-md mx-auto on desktop, full width on mobile) with bottom padding for scrolling.
If user is in Admin View, use a full desktop layout with a persistent dark sidebar.
Implement a clear header toggle: 'Admin View' | 'Employee View'.
For the digital receipt generation, build a visually striking component that looks like a printed thermal receipt or premium ticket. Use a monospace font for receipt numbers.
The 'Share via WhatsApp' button must construct a wa.me URL with properly URI-encoded text containing the receipt details.

Pre-populate the system state with mock arrays for vendors, employees, transactions, and expenses. Ensure actions (like adding a collection) update this mock state so charts and tables react dynamically.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Manrope' for headings/numbers and 'Inter' for body.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals; always use solid white or glassmorphism (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Text alignment should be left by default.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Prioritize using Shadcn UI components and customize them to fit the branding.
